name: Redline Powersports Service
headline: Motorcycle, ATV and sled repair in Howell.
subhead: Two bays, one mechanic, no service writer in between. You talk to the guy doing the work on your machine.

services.name: Engine & drivetrain repair
services.desc: Top-end rebuilds, clutch and belt work, transmission diagnosis. Two- and four-stroke.

services.name: Snowmobile service
services.desc: Pre-season inspections, track and suspension work, carb and clutch tuning. Book by October and skip the January queue.

services.name: ATV & side-by-side
services.desc: CV axles, differentials, winches, electrical gremlins. Utility and sport machines.

services.name: Tires & wheels
services.desc: Mount and balance, tubes, valve stems, bead sealing. Bring the wheel in or the whole bike.

services.name: Diagnostics
services.desc: Runs rough, will not start, dies under load. Flat diagnostic fee applied to the repair if you go ahead.

services.name: Seasonal storage prep
services.desc: Fuel stabilizing, fogging, battery tending, fluid changes. Done right so spring is a non-event.

about:
Redline started in a two-bay pole barn off Grand River in 2011 and has not gotten much bigger since, which is on purpose. Every machine that comes in gets worked on by the same person who quoted it.

We are not a dealership. We do not sell you a new sled when yours needs a clutch. Most of what rolls through here is between eight and twenty years old and worth keeping running.

If you want to know what something costs before we touch it, ask. You will get a real number, not a range.

highlights.You talk to the mechanic: No service advisor, no phone tree, no callback that never comes.
highlights.Straight pricing: Quote before the work starts. If it changes, you hear about it first.
highlights.Older machines welcome: We keep 15-year-old sleds running instead of telling you to replace them.

hours_note: November through February we usually stay open later on weeknights. Call and ask.
